evidence.detail: R86 GpuRuntimeSettings creates rs/k/e directly when the GPU path is enabled, stores it on Client, reuses it across GPU transitions and tears it down when GPU mode is disabled.
The class owns org.lwjgl.opengl.GLCapabilities, GLUtil callback state and a RuneLite AWTContext, and its exact diagnostics require OpenGL 3.1 while conditionally enabling OpenGL 4.3 compute shaders.

Its bytecode directly drives OpenGL texture, vertex-array, buffer, shader/uniform and draw/dispatch APIs, including glBindTexture, glBindVertexArray, glDispatchCompute, glUniform*, glVertexAttrib* and related resource lifecycle calls.
Surviving exact resource/debug identities include scene vertex buffer, scene tex buffer, out vertex buffer, tmp vertex buffer, uniform buffer, uniforms and the diagnostic "Error starting GPU plugin".
Client owns the rs/k/e instance as the active GPU rendering object; R15 GpuPlugin and R86 runtime settings manipulate configuration/state that this object consumes for live rendering.

candidates.note: GpuRenderer is the conservative semantic name for the exact LWJGL/OpenGL rendering engine instantiated by the GPU runtime path. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier; nested shader/buffer helpers remain outside this batch.
